svg.title: The Assistant tab: from a question to an answer
svg.desc: The routing rules, with the language model only for follow-ups or unsure cases, send a question to one of five branches: A forecast (no model), B data (the model writes SQL, checked by guardrails, run on the gold_secure views, then described), C knowledge (hybrid search, then the model answers from the passages), D dictionary and E fixed texts (no model). Then the checks on the way out and what the page shows.
svg.text: a question in the Assistant tab
Reflex app on Azure Container Apps; the
conversation is kept in the server’s memory
Rules (code) look for key words in English and Polish,
in this order: internals → greeting → dictionary →
internals, greeting, dictionary: always the rules alone.
The model does not answer → the rules decide.
The language model – only for a follow-up or when
the rules are unsure: it reads the last 6 messages and
returns JSON – the intent + the question rewritten to
stand alone: “And in Wrocław?” → “Will there be smog
tomorrow in Wrocław?”; the rules check it again.
asks for it: branch C adds
writes it again, up to 3 tries
a column or a table, as
B and C: an answer that names internal tables, the
catalog, paths or keys is withheld
model not answering: 2 retries, then “The language model
is not answering right now…” – A, D and E work without it
the text + a label of its source:
B, C: “Written by the language model (gpt-oss-120b)”
rewritten by the model: “Question understood by the
notes, e.g. SQL tries the guardrails rejected
A, B: the panel “SQL query (through the guardrails)”
B: a table of the rows (up to 50)
One language model for every use: gpt-oss-120b (Cerebras, an OpenAI-compatible API) – no separate SQL model.
The language model never makes up a number: numbers come from the gold_secure views or the quoted documents.
